rust_summary: the in-world key press and release before the game handles it (`native_key_pre`), which a mod can consume.
doc_summary: `native_key_pre(key, pressed, repeat, modifiers, canceled)` hears a keyboard key in the world and on the screens that pass keys on to the game's key bindings, before `native_key` and before any key binding sees it. Set `canceled` and the key is consumed: no binding, no `native_key`, no hotbar slot. Cancel a release only when its press was cancelled, or a binding it started may stay held. Bundles need hooks version @API:key_pre@.
